title: pulquilimiter_b~
description: `pulquilimiter_b~` is a signal limiter that uses an input signal and a side-chain signal generated by `pulqui` or `pulqui~`, acting when the signal exceeds 0 dB; the help patch presents it as providing automatic make-up gain. Its third inlet sets the feedback mix from 0 (limited signal only) to 1 (original signal only).
